newsitem.title: USA: Pioneer Hi-Bred amends rights plan, names chairman.
newsitem.headline: Pioneer Hi-Bred amends rights plan, names chairman.

text.p: Pioneer Hi-Bred International Inc said Friday its directors voted to amend the company's shareholder rights plan and named Charles Johnson as chairman to succeed Thomas Urban.
Directors approved ammendments to the shareholder rights plan which reduce the acquisition threshold and extend the plan through 2006, the company said in a statement.
A company spokesman was not immediately available to provide a reason for the changes.
Johnson, who was elected chairman, also serves as president and chief executive. Urban, who Pioneer said stepped down as planned, will remain a member of the board.
